newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SAARE OLU PLANS 3 MLN KROON INVESTMENT - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: SAARE OLU PLANS 3 MLN KROON INVESTMENT - REPORT.

text.p: Saare Olu, a small Magnum group owned brewery, is planning investments of almost three million kroons in 1997, business newspaper Aripaev said on Friday.
Kaupo Koplus, the company's managing director, was quoted by the newspaper as saying that the money will help to modernise the small brewery.
The modernisation plans include equipment such as a new seperator and a new wharehouse.
The company is looking for a 30 million kroon turnover in 1997 and up to one million kroons profit.
In 1996 the company's turnover was 28 million kroons and it made a two million kroons loss, the newspaper added.
